questions.prompt: Which overall plan matches the ordered interval processing approach for Non Overlapping Intervals?

choices.label: Remove both overlapping intervals every time.
choices.feedback: Removing just one may be sufficient and gives a smaller removal count.

choices.label: Treat meetings that touch at endpoints as overlapping.
choices.feedback: An interval ending when another begins does not overlap in this problem.

choices.label: On an overlap, keep the interval with the larger end.
choices.feedback: The earlier-ending interval leaves more room for future intervals.

choices.label: Sort intervals by start. On overlap remove one and keep the smaller end; otherwise retain the new interval and update the tracked end.
choices.feedback: That matches the selected approach. Sort intervals by start. On overlap remove one and keep the smaller end; otherwise retain the new interval and update the tracked end.
